bug_semantics: POST /api/v2/queries/:queryId (QUERY WRITE) interpolates attacker-controlled parameters into saved MongoDB/REST JSON query templates via Handlebars with noEscaping:true, then JSON.parse of json/customData/requestBody. Quote/brace breakout such as ", "$ne": " turns {"username":"{{username}}"} into {"username":"","$ne":""}, which collection.find/updateMany/deleteMany execute as a broadened filter. validateQueryInputs only rejects Handlebars blocks, not JSON metacharacters.
flaw_origin: f2a025013ea034a86c841e7151c5d38cfdb6acd4 (2022-02-03) first passed noEscaping:true into enrichQueryFields processStringSync and implemented disableEscaping ({{ → {{{) in string-templates. Parent a20249777b41a4ab5564334b0a52e5857b6470d8 already interpolated then JSON.parse'd json/customData/requestBody, but only triple-braced whole-field {{...}} templates; embedded JSON bindings still used Handlebars HTML escaping, which encodes quotes and blocks operator injection. After this commit every binding in a JSON template is unescaped, so user quotes become structural JSON. Precursors: 94ee5855 (handlebars field interpolation) and fc5ebd6b (JSON.parse of interpolated json for MongoDB).

reasoning: CVE-2026-73618 is a real published VulnCheck record (not withdrawn). The sink is authenticated query execution: user parameters are Handlebars-interpolated into a saved JSON MongoDB query body and JSON.parsed into a driver filter. The exploitable step is unescaped interpolation of JSON metacharacters. git history shows JSON.parse of interpolated json from fc5ebd6b (2021-01-15) and processStringSync enrichment from 4960ad76/94ee5855, but until f2a02501 embedded {{bindings}} in JSON templates were HTML-escaped, so a quote-breaking $ne payload could not become structural JSON. f2a02501 is the smallest public commit that first wrote noEscaping:true on that path and implemented disableEscaping globally; its parent lacks noEscaping and still uses whole-field-only triple-brace conversion. That commit is a single-parent human change by mike12345567 with no AI commit-object markers, so authorship is NOT_AI. Vendor GHSA-qw6m-8fw2-2v64 points at PR 18907/2d6c1d17/3.39.9: that merge reverts the short-lived jsonEscape of #18847 and lands processJsonStringSync (dd8c0654), which parses the template before substitution and stops quote-breakout for valid JSON MongoDB bodies. CVE's unaffected 3.40.0 contains 2d6c1d17; 3.38.1 has the BIC and not the fix. Later fail-closed work on multi-object fallback (1e7166ec, 2026-08-07) is after 3.40.0 and is not required to close this advisory's quoted-JSON PoC.
